notes: Resolution, frame rate, and aspect ratio can be verified from the MP4.
The advertised FOV does not identify whether delivered video is rectilinear, fisheye, dewarped, cropped, or stabilized.
RSWIDE1080P30FPS, Wide FOV, and RockSteady enabled are user-declared capture settings.
The f/2.8 aperture does not determine radial or tangential distortion.
Nominal FOV-derived focal estimates are provenance only and are not used for WiLoR projection.
WiLoR retains its image-size focal heuristic because hand overlay alignment is validated independently in image space.
